theorems.name: Submission.gwe_graph_tilt_algebra
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (D : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), ‖D‖ ≤ 1 → hsNormSq D ≤ ((ℓ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * hsNormSq ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (D v)))).starProjection - (rotatedPlane q).starProjection) ∧ ∀ (j : Fin ℓ) (r w : Rn n), (∀ v : Rn n, inner ℝ r v = D v j) → |inner ℝ ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (D v)))).starProjection (q (graphPoint 0 (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))))) ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (D v)))).starProjection (q (graphPoint w 0))) - inner ℝ r w| ≤ hsNormSq ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (D v)))).starProjection - (rotatedPlane q).starProjection) * ‖w‖
